'''Étoile Carouge FC''' is a Swiss football team based in [[Carouge]]. The club was founded in 1904. As of the 2024–25 season. They play in the [[Swiss Challenge League|Challenge League]], the second tier of Swiss football, following their promotion from the [[2023–24 Promotion League]]. The team play their home games at [[Stade de la Fontenette]], which seats up to 3,690 spectators."}}
